podcast.title: Supporting Act for The Outfield (1985)
podcast.body: Black 'n Blue were advertised as special guests supporting The Outfield for a concert in Cleveland in 1985. "special guests, Black and Blue."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Weird History of Concert Tickets Part 1

xref.title: 1985 Cleveland Concert Advertisement
xref.body: A vintage commercial from 1985 promoted The Outfield's concert in Cleveland, with special guests Black 'n Blue, live at a "rich, no-comical theater." The face value of a ticket for this show was $14. "This is coming to Cleveland, and the walls are vibrating. The open production is recent, and special guests, Black and Blue. Live with the rich, no-comical theater."
